info.name: TRADElogs — Elefin partner onboarding and referrals
info.description: A partner’s Elefin onboarding and the referral flow end to end, against a fake Elefin. Run with run-elefin.sh.

item.name: Not a partner yet: no Elefin page

exec: pm.test("primary code is the one from the application", () => { pm.expect(d.codes.find(c => c.isPrimary).code).to.eql(pm.variables.get('shashCode')); });
pm.test("nothing clicked yet", () => { pm.expect(d.totals).to.eql({ clicks: 0, converted: 0, signups: 0 }); });

item.name: Not connected; the IPs to allow are listed
Half a key → 422 before calling Elefin
A key Elefin doesn’t know → invalid_key
A key not allowed from our IPs → ip_blocked, says which IPs to allow

exec: pm.test("says the allow-list is the problem", () => { pm.expect(d.message).to.include('allow-list'); });
pm.test("lists all three IPs to ask for", () => { pm.expect(d.missing).to.eql(['IP allow-list: 152.55.180.240, 162.220.234.242, 152.55.180.242']); });

pm.test("the key’s secret is never sent back", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('goodSecret')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('lockedSecret')); });
pm.test("probe failed, still not connected", () => { pm.expect(d.probe.outcome).to.eql('ip_blocked'); pm.expect(d.connection.state).to.eql('NOT_CONNECTED'); pm.expect(d.sync).to.eql(null); });

pm.test("the key’s secret is never sent back", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('goodSecret')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('lockedSecret')); });

item.name: The real key: connect and first sync

exec: pm.test("Elefin says whose key it is", () => { pm.expect(d.probe.ok).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.probe.key.partnerName).to.eql('shashwat verma'); pm.expect(d.probe.key.partnerId).to.eql(23); pm.expect(d.probe.key.keyName).to.eql('Shash IB'); });
pm.test("/me lists no abilities (like live Elefin) but it reads clients", () => { pm.expect(d.probe.key.abilities).to.eql([]); pm.expect(d.probe.key.canReadClients).to.eql(true); });

pm.test("first sync read the whole book", () => { pm.expect(d.sync.ok).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.connection.state).to.eql('OK'); pm.expect(d.connection.roster.total).to.eql(pm.variables.get('bookSize') * 1); });
pm.test("only the last 4 characters are shown", () => { pm.expect(d.connection.keyHint).to.eql('••••' + pm.variables.get('goodSecret').slice(-4)); });

pm.test("the key’s secret is never sent back", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('goodSecret')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('lockedSecret')); });

pm.test("connected, synced, nobody referred yet", () => { pm.expect(d.state).to.eql('OK'); pm.expect(d.lastSuccessAt).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(d.verification.referred).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.events[0].status).to.eql('ok'); });
pm.test("funded and lots from Elefin", () => { pm.expect(d.roster.funded).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(d.roster.lots).to.be.above(0); });

pm.test("the key’s secret is never sent back", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('goodSecret')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('lockedSecret')); });

pm.test("connected with the book size", () => { pm.expect(r.state).to.eql('OK'); pm.expect(r.elefinPartner).to.eql('shashwat verma'); pm.expect(r.clients).to.eql(pm.variables.get('bookSize') * 1); });

pm.test("the key’s secret is never sent back", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('goodSecret')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('lockedSecret')); });

item.name: Unconfirmed emails: Elefin isn’t asked yet

exec: pm.test("4 referred, all waiting", () => { pm.expect(d.verification).to.include({ referred: 4, verified: 0, held: 0, notFound: 0, waiting: 4 }); });

item.name: Asha (Elefin client, active) is verified by Elefin
Eve (came by link, active) is verified
Ben (another IB’s client at Elefin) is not found, and told why

exec: pm.test("reason names the partner", () => { pm.expect(d.elefin.reason).to.include('doesn’t list your email under Shashwat');  });

item.name: Chen (Shash’s client, suspended at Elefin) is held
Dev (no link, no code) has no partner and no check
Elefin was asked exactly four times
Dev types Shash’s code after signing up
Dev is checked with Elefin too

exec: pm.test("5 referred: 3 verified, 1 held, 1 not found", () => { pm.expect(d.verification).to.include({ referred: 5, verified: 3, held: 1, notFound: 1, waiting: 0 }); });
pm.test("2 of the verified have deposited", () => { pm.expect(d.verification.verifiedFunded).to.eql(2); });
const rows = d.clients ?? d.items ?? d.rows ?? d; const by = n => rows.find(r => r.name.startsWith(n));

pm.test("all five, with how they came", () => { pm.expect(rows.length).to.eql(5); pm.expect(by('Eve').via).to.eql('link'); pm.expect(by('Asha').via).to.eql('code'); pm.expect(by('Dev').via).to.eql('late'); });

pm.test("verified through Elefin", () => { for (const n of ['Asha', 'Eve', 'Dev']) pm.expect(by(n).ib.verifiedBrokers, n).to.include('elefin'); for (const n of ['Ben', 'Chen']) pm.expect(by(n).ib.verifiedBrokers, n).to.not.include('elefin'); });

pm.test("verified before connecting MT5; the others wait for an account", () => { pm.expect(by('Asha').ib.verification).to.eql('VERIFIED'); pm.expect(by('Ben').ib.verification).to.eql('NO_ACCOUNT'); });
pm.test("same numbers", () => { pm.expect(d.verification).to.include({ referred: 5, verified: 3, held: 1, notFound: 1 }); });

pm.test("the key’s secret is never sent back", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('goodSecret')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('lockedSecret')); });

item.name: 08 A package unlocks for verified clients
Shash publishes a package for verified Elefin clients

exec: pm.test("active", () => { const p = d.packages.find(x => x.name === 'Elefin VIP'); pm.expect(p.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); });
pm.test("locked with a reason", () => { const p = d.packages.find(x => x.name === 'Elefin VIP'); pm.expect(p.status).to.eql('LOCKED'); pm.expect(p.reasons.length).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test("paused, partner asked for the key again", () => { pm.expect(d.connection.state).to.eql('PAUSED'); pm.expect(d.connection.lastError).to.include('Add your key again'); });

item.name: Partner can’t “Sync now” a paused key

exec: pm.test("the key’s secret is never sent back", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('goodSecret')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('lockedSecret')); });

item.name: Elefin: locks the key to other IPs
Sync is refused; the partner is told which IPs to allow

exec: pm.test("error naming the IPs", () => { pm.expect(d.result.ok).to.eql(false); pm.expect(d.connection.state).to.eql('ERROR'); pm.expect(d.connection.lastError).to.include('allow-list'); for (const ip of ['152.55.180.240', '162.220.234.242', '152.55.180.242']) pm.expect(d.connection.lastError).to.include(ip); });
pm.test("and that the call didn’t come from one of them", () => { pm.expect(d.connection.lastError).to.include('Elefin saw 127.0.0.1'); });
pm.test("not connected, nothing cached", () => { pm.expect(d.state).to.eql('NOT_CONNECTED'); pm.expect(d.keyHint).to.eql(null); pm.expect(d.roster).to.eql(null); });
